title: Line-level tax attributes (v1)
status: PROPOSAL except where a row says CONFIRMED. Values are closed sets; a new value needs a reviewed change.
principle: Tax meaning lives on the journal line and in the mapping rules, never on the account (journey s7.1; sheets.md s8 #1: 'salaries' feeds 1601-C II.14 and 1701-MS IV.10A).
layers: mapping rules (line attributes to form fields, versioned)

money.text: exactly two decimal places in JSON, for example "200000.00"; more than two decimals is refused
money.floats: not allowed in Books money paths
money.sign: signed; no clamp to zero; overpayment is a separate signed line

dates.recognition_date: DATE; may differ from entry date when the recognition rule says so (decision D4 open)
dates.certificate_period: period_start and period_end as DATE (BK-TS uses text: tax-certificates.ts:53-54)

line_attributes.name: tax_type
line_attributes.rule: Which tax the line belongs to. Drives the form family. VAT and expanded withholding are later phases (P10+).
citations: workbook Build notes row 10 (distinct tax types and roles)

line_attributes.name: atc
line_attributes.rule: Alphanumeric tax code. Closed set in MVP. PT010 = persons exempt from VAT under Sec. 109(BB) (Sec. 116), 3% (printed Table 1). WB080/WB082 = creditable percentage-tax withholding (2307). WB084 = final, Section 116 applies (2306). WW010 = compensation withholding (1601-C preprinted).

line_attributes.name: treatment
line_attributes.rule: How the line enters the tax computation. An account never implies a treatment (sheets.md s8 #1).

line_attributes.name: income_class
line_attributes.rule: Which income or cost bucket the line feeds: 1701-MS IV.5 (business sales), IV.6 (contra), IV.13 or IV.20 (non-operating), IV.8 (cost).

line_attributes.name: regime
line_attributes.rule: Per taxable year. Income-tax rate regime. 'unknown' blocks output. Mixed earners cannot use the 250,000 reduction.

line_attributes.name: vat_status
line_attributes.rule: Per taxable year. A VAT-registered person cannot use the 8% option. Posted sales above the threshold force VAT.

line_attributes.name: returns_state
line_attributes.rule: Per quarter. A return or credit note in the quarter blocks the 2551Q until a person acknowledges it.

line_attributes.name: person_scope
line_attributes.rule: Whose tax the line belongs to. Spouse is out of MVP; employee comes with P6 (1601-C); payor with P4 (certificates).

line_attributes.name: counterparty_kind
line_attributes.rule: What kind of party is on the line. The party is referenced by an opaque party_ref. No TIN is stored on a line.
citations: books.md s2 (parties; TIN columns are plaintext in Books)

line_attributes.name: party_ref
allowed_values: opaque UUID (never a TIN, never a name)
line_attributes.rule: Reference to a party record kept by Books. No TIN, branch or legal name appears here.

line_attributes.name: comp_component
line_attributes.rule: Payroll component of a compensation line (P6). Maps to 1601-C II.14-II.20. Mandatory contributions and union dues feed II.19 only at the employee share.

line_attributes.name: contribution_side
line_attributes.rule: Whose share a statutory contribution is. Employee share goes to 1601-C II.19. Employer share goes to expense and to the payable account, never to II.19 (EXC.EMPLOYER_SHARE_NOT_19).

line_attributes.name: credit_kind
line_attributes.rule: Which tax a withholding credit reduces. pt = percentage tax (2551Q II.15). it = income tax (1701-MS V.3-V.5, including the 2316 credit in V.5, and 1701Q). Routing by ATC series: WB = pt; WI and WC = it (INFERENCE from the form headings, bir.md W-3). WB084 is final and never credited.

line_attributes.name: certificate_status
line_attributes.rule: Status of a 2307 or 2306 certificate. Only 'received' credits. Pending, lost and disputed never post a receivable (books.md s4g: BK-TS does not check it).

line_attributes.name: document_kind
line_attributes.rule: Kind of evidence document. A credit_note blocks 2551Q until acknowledged (UNCONFIRMED for 2551Q, bir.md PT-8). certificate_2307 is the only certificate type that can credit.
citations: workbook Category field rules (credit note rows)

line_attributes.name: evidence_ref
line_attributes.rule: Pointer to stored evidence. The model sees the sha256 and kind only; OCR text is not sent by default (design R-23).

line_attributes.name: tax_period_key
line_attributes.rule: Explicit override of the default period derived from the recognition date. The default is the calendar day in Asia/Manila. The PT timing basis (invoice, receipt or entry date) is UNKNOWN (decision D4).

line_attributes.name: final_tax_flag
line_attributes.rule: Whether the income was final-taxed (excluded from graduated or 8% business lines). Books does not store this today (sheets.md s10: UNKNOWN).

line_attributes.name: deductibility
line_attributes.rule: Whether a cost line can reach 1701-MS IV.8 or IV.10A. Itemized only. OSD and 8% do not deduct it separately.

line_attributes.name: election_event
line_attributes.rule: Dated 8% or graduated election record per taxable year. The 8% election is irrevocable within the year. Stored as an event, not overwritten (BK-TS upserts it; books.md s2).

line_attributes.name: sign_and_rounding
allowed_values: signed amounts; rounding at output only
line_attributes.rule: Totals keep their sign. Half-away rounding is applied once, at the output line (decision D7, PROPOSAL; Forms rounding statement pending).

sale_line.description: Synthetic sale on a non-VAT, graduated profile

void_reversal_line.description: Reversal of the synthetic 100000.00 sale, dated the original date (design A4)

forbidden_in_books: BIR tickets (tkt_...) or Rox tokens in records
credit from pending, lost or disputed certificates
